title: Slocum Test
note: Generated by tools/figures.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification and source fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. A figure the reviewer corrects or deletes is marked REMOVED rather than removed from this file.

figures.claim: Position the patient supine with the knee flexed to about ninety degrees and the foot flat on the couch, as for an anterior drawer.
Rotate the foot externally by about fifteen degrees and sit on it to hold it there.
Then rotate the foot internally by about thirty degrees, hold it, and draw forwards again, this time watching the lateral plateau.
The expected points are the ninety degree position, the amount of rotation in each direction, holding the foot, watching the plateau rather than the tubercle, and the neutral comparison.
